# Burlesque To Go

> Las Vegas burlesque entertainment on demand — classy tease-not-strip performances delivered to private events, with a roster of professional dancers, aerialists and specialty acts.

Founded by Fawnia Dietrich. Performances from $150; booking by SMS at 702-205-1440. The aim is to tease and insinuate, never to expose — burlesque as theatrical art.

- [What Is Burlesque?](/what-is-burlesque): The art form explained
